That's just right. As soon as I typed "typo," the "typography" suggestion popped up marked as an existing label, and clicking it dropped it straight onto the card as a pill — no need to finish typing or worry about whether I'd spelled it the same as last time. That's exactly the quick, duplicate-resistant feeling I was after: it steers me back to the label I already have instead of letting me accidentally make a near-copy.

Suggestions showing up right as I type, and picking one finishing the job in a click — yes, that's the labeling experience I wanted. Happy with this.
